channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: 90-Year-Old Allegedly Mis-Sold ₹2 Lakh-a-Year Life Insurance Policy Maturing in 2124; Canara Bank Responds
item.description: Canara Bank in Nagpur bank faces scrutiny after a 90-year-old man was allegedly pressured into buying an insurance policy maturing decades later.

item.title: Logical Take | Trusting the Teacher: Why India’s Learning Crisis Is a Policy Choice
item.description: While global PISA toppers build learning systems around teacher trust and autonomy, India prioritises control-undermining classroom outcomes.

item.title: White House Revises India‑US Trade Fact Sheet: Pulses Dropped, Digital Taxes Clarified, $500B Deal Updated
item.description: The White House fact sheet on the interim India‑US trade deal was quietly corrected after New Delhi’s intervention, adjusting tariff, digital tax, and purchase commitments.

item.title: Two Tragedies in Four Days: Rohini and Janakpuri Open Drains and Pits Claim Delhi Residents’ Lives
item.description: A week after a biker’s death in Janakpuri, another man dies in Rohini’s uncovered drain, raising urgent questions on Delhi’s public safety standards.

item.title: India’s IT Rules Now Mandate AI Content Labels and 3‑Hour Takedowns to Tackle Deepfakes and Harmful Media
item.description: New IT Rules require social media platforms to clearly label AI‑generated content and remove unlawful posts within three hours of notification to curb deepfakes, misinformation and abusive synthetic media.

item.title: February 12 Nationwide Bank Strike: SBI Alerts Customers to Possible Service Disruptions Across India
item.description: Major bank unions have called a one-day nationwide strike on 12 February 2026, prompting SBI and other public sector lenders to warn customers of possible service disruptions while digital banking remains operational.

item.title: 30 Crore Workers to Join Nationwide Strike on February 12 Over Labour Reforms, Say Trade Unions
item.description: Trade unions have confirmed a nationwide general strike on 12 February, expecting up to 30 crore workers to protest labour codes, privatisation, and rural employment law changes, with backing from farmer groups and sectoral unions nationwide. item.description: Uttar Pradesh police arrested five men in Ghaziabad for allegedly operating a multi-state counterfeit medicine racket, seizing around 50,000 fake Himalaya Liv-52 tablets, packaging materials and a car, as the investigation intensifies to trace wider distribution networks. item.title: Delhi Launches Lakhpati Bitiya Yojana Offering ₹56,000 Support, Over ₹1 Lakh After Graduation
item.description: Delhi’s new Lakhpati Bitiya Yojana will provide financial aid of ₹56,000 to girls from birth to graduation, maturing to over ₹1 lakh to promote education and empowerment.

item.title: 98X Coliform in Amul Milk? The Viral Claim and Amul’s Response Explained
item.description: Independent testing has sparked a public debate over packaged Amul milk hygiene, with brands defending their quality checks and regulators yet to issue a formal clarification.
